'''Bant Defula''' was supposedly a senior executive at [[Astrotours Limited/Legends|Astrotours Limited]], and had the lease on [[Lumiya]]'s apartment at [[Zorp House]]. In reality it was a person with connections to the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], apparently to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="Tempest">[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]</ref>
